title: The Kottke.org Video Closet
content:
Ok folks, I’m gonna apologize in advance for totally ruining any plans you might have had for the rest of your day. This weekend I knocked together the Video Closet, a simple tool for exploring & watching every YouTube & Vimeo video1 I’ve posted to KDO since 2014 that’s still live: almost 5400 of them in total. It’s like a YouTube that’s just for people who read KDO. Click a video to play it or click the title to go to the original post containing the video.

The toughest thing about building the Video Closet was getting repeatedly distracted by videos while I was testing it. Seriously, don’t open this thing if you want to get any work done for the rest of the day!

I also tweaked how video embeds work on the main site: there’s now a play button (plays the video in place), an “open on [service]” button (opens it in a new tab on YT or Vimeo), and, on desktop browsers, a widescreen button that embiggens the video in the current window and plays it (my favorite). I like rolling my own video embeds because the default ones from YT & Vimeo are heavy and include a lot of tracking — and now you can choose three different ways of watching, according to the customs of your people.

See also a bunch of other stuff I’ve launched lately.

  1. I didn’t include Instagram because Instagram doesn’t want to be part of the open internet, their embeds suck, and a few more reasons I could probably think up if I wanted to spend any more precious seconds on this. ↩
